newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Automation mulls bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Automation mulls bonus issue.

text.p: Shanghai Automation Instrumentation Co Ltd said on Saturday it planned to make a one-for-10 bonus share issue based on 1996 profits.
Shareholders approved the plan at a meeting on June 20, the company said in a statement in the Shanghai Securities News.
The ex-rights date was July 8, with final B share trading the day before, the statement said. The new shares would be listed on July 10, the statement said.

The company reported a 40.88 percent drop in net profit to 26.72 million yuan in 1996, compared with 45.19 million in 1995 based on international accounting standards, due to tougher market conditions.
